signals.text: A standing order repays a private loan to Andrea Widmer.
On average 250.82 was left per month over the last 6 months; in 3 months more went out than came in (2026-05, 2026-06, 2026-10).
Sparkonto holds 4'919.20, 49 % of its goal "Notgroschen CHF 10'000".
Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Bern is due on 30.11.2026: 1'180.00, "Steuern 2026, 3. Rate (provisorisch)".
Paid into pillar 3a in 2026: 3'300.00 of the maximum 7'258.00; after the standing orders 3'658.00 is missing.
6 payments of together 3'155.45 are due in the next 30 days.
Regular payments that cost more within a year: KPT Krankenkasse AG from 296.80 to 399.40 on 24.12.2025.
On 23.12.2026, the day before the next salary, 5'363.93 is left on Privatkonto after 6 payments, 198.66 a day. A month's spending is about 5'395.90.
Spending averaged 5'511.93 a month over the last 6 months, highest in 2026-06.
6 payments of together 3'155.45 leave before the salary on 24.12.2026.
The 6 largest monthly payments add up to 2'103.25 a month.
